correctness.rationale: For n=4,5 the q_k inclusion-exclusion polynomial is homogeneous of degree n in sorted probability gaps δ_r=p_r−p_(r+1)≥0. Reconstruct M_(k,j)=S(n,k)(j)_k/j^n; triangular invertibility yields unique w=M^-1 q. Independently computed every rational coefficient in all C(2n−1,n)=35/126 gap monomials: none negative; counts per j for n=4 are 26,27,24,14 positive and n=5 112,113,108,85,42. Therefore all real δ≥0 give w≥0; column normalization forces Σw=1. Uniform parents attain the simplex vertices. Padded zeros, degenerate parents and boundary gaps are covered; not asserted for n≥6 or >n labels. Verification script and displayed formulas mutually agree; finite search exhausts the polynomial coefficient set, not probability input grid.
